fields.body: Installed two east gate handholes at Birch Hub under original C-14. A message about Alpine Hub’s additions circulated, but we have received no changes for Birch. Work matches our tender locations and quantities.
Birch Hub original contract drawing: two handholes HH-1 and HH-2 at east gate. No revision. This is not Alpine Hub C-14.

The direction to add two east gate handholes is for Alpine Hub only. Birch Hub already has these two in its original scope; make no scope adjustment to Birch and do not charge Alpine work to this project.
